reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: Ta has lower electronegativity than Mo, similar atomic size, and is a known BCC stabilizer, so partial substitution should reduce bonding heterogeneity and improve plasticity while largely retaining solid-solution strengthening.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with specific composition, processing, characterization, and quantitative falsification criteria (strength drop >10%, plasticity increase <20%), though the 20% plasticity threshold is somewhat arbitrary.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis directly addresses the research question with a concrete, well-justified intervention and a testable prediction, making it highly useful for guiding experimental work on this alloy system.
